The '''6/37th''' was the sixth [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of the [[37th Imperial Fighter Wing]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

[[File:ReslianPurge-XWingRogueSquadron25.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Tunroth]]s fight against the [[Reslian Purge]] with the aid of the 6/37th.]]

The squadron [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and was based aboard the ''[[Abrogator]]''. [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] was assigned to the 6/37th, under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lun Tessra]]. [[Zelen]] also flew as a part of the unit. Just after Fel transferred, the 37th was engaged in [[Battle of Saloch|combat]] at [[Saloch²]]. Fel eventually rose to command the unit.
